newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end down, market focused on spread.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end down, market focused on spread.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled down on local selling of both futures and options with two trading days left in the March contract, dealers said.
Open interest in the spot month remains high at 5,867 lots, down only 506 lots, ahead of the first notice day on March 3.
"We'll know the real story Monday when we see what kind of liquidation we did this week, but we could be in for some good deliveries," an analyst said.
The market remained focused on the March/May spread and rolling March contracts into May.
The most-active month closed at a premium of 2.65 cents, ending down 0.40 to 81.45 cents. Spot March settled at 78.80, off 1.00.
Volume was estimated at 4,350 compared with Tuesday's official volume of 3,624 lots.
